independence_hierarchy.independence: not independent of its camera environment
correlated within a fixed camera environment
observed only through the camera's view; a component of the environment

data_problem.independent_unit: camera environment (stationary camera + printer + site/background/lighting; bundles sensor, optics, view, lighting, background, printer-appearance)

measured_evidence.printing_errors: 151 recordings, 1 creator site, 1 camera model (ELP), 1 naming/site pattern -> temporal diversity, zero environmental diversity
measured_evidence.stage13_normal: 333 frames from 7 sources collapsed held-out normal FPR 1.000 -> 0.258 (largest measured single effect)
measured_evidence.stage14_failure: 100 frames from 2 cameras caused environment overfitting in Exp4
measured_evidence.lesson: frames/videos are not the unit; environment count measures generalization; class balance must be struck across environments, not frames

requirements: independent cameras (no single sensor/optics model clustering)
lighting variety (day/night, enclosure LEDs, white balance)
failure footage with onset and development (continuous, fixed camera)
data_problem.counting_rule: per-environment frame cap sampled evenly across run duration; environment count is the target, not frame count

public_footage.independent_normal_environments_continuo: ~5-8 discoverable, ~3-5 active; ceiling ~8-12 across all platforms
public_footage.printers_cameras_identifiable: yes for well-documented channels; mostly not otherwise
public_footage.frames_extractable: yes for normal live streams; mostly no for failures (short clips, timelapses, compilations, tutorials)
public_footage.license: Standard YouTube License default; downloading violates ToS; redistribution clearly prohibited; training use unsettled
public_footage.third_party_training_mechanism: Dec-2024 YouTube third-party-AI setting targets large AI companies, not open-source projects
public_footage.scalability: cannot scale past Stage 13/14 as-is; supplemental normal source only

existing_datasets.note: Trier, Bambu, Bed-Adhesion verified directly during this study; others per subagent research flagged for verification

datasets.name: Trier FFF QC Dataset v2
datasets.environments: single site, 3 fixed camera angles (exact count UNVERIFIED)
datasets.size: ~48 GB, exact frame count TO VERIFY

datasets.name: Bambu Timelapse Dataset
datasets.note: contribution-based growth model to replicate; timelapses are skimmed

datasets.name: Bed-Adhesion Failure-Onset
datasets.note: only onset-annotated failure corpus; NC license + YT-hosted videos require containment

datasets.name: small already-recorded sets
datasets.license: mixed (Hu MIT 1,912; Roboflow seprinder/syLucauc CC BY 4.0; Kaggle 3D-printer-defected unverified; Javiai unknown)

observations: Trier is the only large permissively-licensed in-production corpus (CC BY 4.0, ~48 GB, 3 fixed angles)
Bambu: 627 timelapses from ~3 contributors ~= 3 environments (volume != environments)
Bed-Adhesion is the only onset-annotated failure corpus; bed-adhesion-only and NC
Academic papers recycle the same tiny Kaggle/Roboflow sets; more papers != more environments
Obico/Spaghetti Detective ~90M printing hours monitored but NO public dataset
no dataset fills continuous under-extrusion / multi-env spaghetti onset

synthetic.fmd_defect_rendering: no verified Blender/simulator pipeline exists for spaghetti/stringing/under-extrusion; novel research not a tool
synthetic.photometric_augmentation_gap: refuted for environment diversity; Xiao et al. 2024 leaves persistent 4-14% accuracy gap vs real diversity
synthetic.cutpaste_compositing: best evidence (steel NEU-DET): peaks at n=50/class (mAP@50 +6.2pp), Poisson n=100, monotonic degradation beyond (features shift toward augmented distribution); ControlNet-underperforms-cut-paste
synthetic.generative_defect_synthesis: promising on MVTec-AD/NEU-DET; zero verified 3D-print evidence; SynSur: synthetic-only never replaces real data
decisions: cannot fix environmental diversity (requires real footage from more real environments)
can modestly help defect diversity via volume-capped cut/paste of real failure pixels onto real normal backgrounds
pursue ONLY as later bounded augmentation after real environment targets met; no rendering/generative pipelines now

within_corpus_levers: source/run-level stratification with per-environment frame caps
temporal spread sampling (stride full run duration)
hard-normal mining from frozen train normals + SKZ candidate normals (after human verification)
failure-onset preservation (Stage 14 already has onset windows)
better_use_of_existing_footage.verdict: bounded gain; rebalances and hardens but cannot add environments; not a standalone strategy

rows.diversity: high in defect appearance, low for real environments

decision_matrix.conclusion: only combination addresses the measured blocker (environment count) at attainable cost

normal.printer_camera_diversity: >=3-4 printer models; cameras not a single model; >=2 of bed/front/side/overhead layouts
normal.continuous_requirement: per env >=1 complete healthy run or >=2 h continuous ~1 fps (~>=7200 raw frames), sampled to per-env cap
normal.covariate_spread: bed types, colors, lighting, filament colors/materials deliberately diversified

failure.onset_coverage: every failure env: continuous onset + development window, not aftermath stills

evaluation.new_holdouts: 2-3 new normal envs + 2-3 new failure envs frozen before training

dataset_design.credibility: first design where independent-unit count (~25-35 envs) is the explicit target; ~40% of normals and ~5-6 failure envs already in hand

evaluation_only: Bed-Adhesion sequences (if NC kept out of release)
permissioned channels unless grant covers redistribution
manual_verification_required: YouTube videoTrainability state + written per-uploader grant for any channel

salvageability.q1_build_dataset_without_owning_printer: yes, via permissive corpora + contributor program; cannot fabricate failures at will; socially driven and slower
salvageability.q2_public_footage_enough_normals: only with permission; ~8-12 envs absolute ceiling; supplemental not sufficient
salvageability.q3_public_footage_enough_failures: no; ~1-3 envs and essentially no continuous onset footage; binding constraint
salvageability.q4_research_datasets_fill_gaps: partially; Trier bulk, Bed-Adhesion 2 onset envs, Bambu normals; NOT continuous under-extrusion or multi-env spaghetti onset
salvageability.q5_synthetic_worth_pursuing: only cut-paste compositing as bounded augmentation after real targets; rendering/generative not evidence-backed
salvageability.q7_min_acquisition_for_training_run: train-side env count ~doubles (~10 -> ~20), >=5 new verified failure envs (>=2 spaghetti, >=3 under-extrusion), 2 normal + 2 failure new holdouts frozen; until then do not train

recommendation.strategy: Hybrid — permissive research datasets (Trier, Bambu, Bed-Adhesion-contained, small MIT sets) as bulk backbone, PLUS contributor/self-collection for genuinely new camera environments, PLUS permissioned YouTube as supplemental normal source, PLUS (after real targets met) volume-capped real-defect cut-paste compositing
recommendation.why: attacks the measured blocker (camera-environment count) at attainable cost and licensing; alternatives fail on license/scarcity/gap/evidence respectively
recommendation.data_to_collect: 6-10 new normal envs + 4-6 new failure envs (>=2 spaghetti, >=3 under-extrusion) continuous-onset, human-verified, CC BY 4.0
recommendation.data_to_reuse: Trier v2, Bambu, Bed-Adhesion (NC-contained), Stage 13/14 + SKZ where already split, printing-errors frozen
recommendation.still_missing: continuous under-extrusion footage, multi-env spaghetti onset, independent normals beyond existing corpora
recommendation.estimated_scale: ~25-35 independent environments; ~30-50k annotated frames at ~1 fps
recommendation.licensing_considerations: provenance ledger per dataset policy; NC data in eval/training-only trenches; only CC BY/MIT/Apache in redistribution artifact; own data CC BY 4.0
recommendation.next_implementation_task: build dataset-staging + contributor-intake pipeline: characterize Trier v2 (counts/license/checksums), verify Bambu envs, extend Stage-12D review manifest + environment-manifest schema, ship contributor intake kit; freeze new holdouts; NO training

do_not_pursue: scraping YouTube/platform footage for training without per-uploader permission
including Standard-YouTube-License frames in the redistribution release
generative/diffusion or rendered synthetic FDM data as primary source
full-scene FDM defect rendering (unproven, high-cost research)
frame-random train/eval splits at any level
re-using 7-video holdout / Stage-13 eval / SKZ eval for training
another training run before min-acquisition conditions met
arbitrary frame-count inflation from any single environment
